quest.title: Sight-Singing & Ear Quest
quest.subtitle: Progress from guided staff echoing, scaffolded sight-singing, and functional 'Sing-It-Home' single-note resolution to full violin transcription.
quest.modeFoundationSub: Guided Echo → Sight-Singing → Sing-It-Home → Fill-in-the-Blank (Relative Pitch)
quest.singLockSuccess: ✅ Vocal sequence locked in! Ghost scale degrees are now lit on the staff — pick up your violin for Phase 2!
quest.singLockPrompt: Phase 1 (🎤 Sing first): Hum or sing the phrase into the mic to verify your audiation
quest.violinRealisePrompt: Phase 2 (🎻 Play on violin): Use your unlocked staff contour to play it in tune

echo.name: 0.1 Guided Echo · Staff + Audio
echo.blurb: Full five-line staff + demo audio + tonic drone. Sing or play along to calibrate ear, voice, and fingerboard.

sight.name: 0.2 Scaffolded Sight-Singing
sight.blurb: Plays ONLY the tonic cadence + starting note! Read the staff (with ghost stepping-stones on leaps) and sing/play.

home.name: 0.3 Sing-It-Home · Single Note
home.blurb: Hear the cadence + 1 mystery tone. Sing/play the mystery tone AND walk it home to Tonic Do (e.g. Mi → Re → Do)!

fill.name: 0.4 Fill-in-the-Blank · Hybrid
fill.blurb: Sight-read the printed first half of the measure, then seamlessly ear-transcribe the hidden `?` ending.

rungs.2: Rung 2 · Major Triad (1̂ Do · 3̂ Mi · 5̂ Sol)
rungs.3: Rung 3 · Tonic Gravity (1̂ · 2̂ Re · 3̂ Mi · 7̂ Ti)

quest.homeInstruction: 💡 Goal: After the cadence (1̂-5̂-1̂), you heard 1 mystery note. Sing/play that note AND resolve it home to Tonic D (1̂ Do)!

1.name: Groping
1.blurb: One position, stepwise motion. Build the hear-it-then-find-it reflex.

2.name: Leaps
2.blurb: Thirds, fourths and fifths. Interval recognition proper.

3.name: Rhythm
3.blurb: Unequal note values. The long-short ratios have to be clean.

4.name: Transposition
4.blurb: The same shape, moved to another key.

5.name: Shifting
5.blurb: Past first position. The hand has to travel.

6.name: Repertoire
6.blurb: Longer phrases, closer to real music.
